verdict.rationale: Typesense Cloud has a public pricing calculator. It describes a node/cluster-based model: a dedicated cluster with no limits on records or operations, plus configurable add-ons like High Availability, Search Delivery Network and GPU acceleration. That structure supports cost predictability, and the open-source server can also be self-hosted. However, the evidence never shows actual per-unit prices, so a founder cannot confirm from this pack what search will cost. Missing for 10: actual published per-node/per-hour dollar rates, a worked cost example, and independent confirmation that bills match the calculator.
